description: Second rerun of smoke-keifu (both arms). Its first start broke because Zeroshot 10.8.0's run controller leaves processes orphaned in other process groups as zombies: keifu's agents test the terminal UI in pseudo-terminals and tmux, and the containers reached the 8,192-process limit. The first rerun (smoke-keifu-v2) ran `codex` under agent/codex-reaper.c, which reaped orphans only while their node ran; a tmux server a node left running kept creating orphans after the node ended, and one loop passed 23,000 processes in 50 minutes. This start's reaper also ends what a node leaves running when its Codex exits (resources.reap_orphans); everything else is smoke-keifu's. Pipeline smoke test for luna-xhigh-keifu-v3 and sol-xhigh-keifu-single-v3: the same task adjustments, graphs and evaluation with one short loop run of 3 rounds.

task.adjustments_rationale: As in the svgbob experiments v2 to v5, the reference moves to a root-owned directory outside the workspace (the task statement points there), so builders cannot overwrite or delete it at the build target's path. This adjustment is general, not specific to the task. The bundled documentation is left as shipped: no task-specific corrections.
